h: 'Kindergarten Cop' child actor Christian Cousins found dead in California
p: Christian Cousins, who appeared as a child alongside Arnold Schwarzenegger in 'Kindergarten Cop', has been found dead at his home in California. Police say there were no suspicious circumstances; his half-brother said he had been seriously ill with liver disease.
body: Christian Cousins, the former child actor best known for the 1990 comedy 'Kindergarten Cop', has died.

Police in Irvine, California, said officers went to his home on 20 October after his family requested a welfare check because they could not reach him, and found him dead inside. They said there were no suspicious circumstances. The county coroner took custody of his remains, and no official cause of death has been released. News of his death spread this week after his half-brother, Jonas Roeser, posted a tribute on Instagram, saying Cousins had been seriously ill with liver disease.
Cousins and his twin brother, Joseph, shared the role of Dominic Palmieri in 'Kindergarten Cop', starring Arnold Schwarzenegger.
more: Cousins was found dead at home in October.
Police say there was nothing suspicious.
He had reportedly been ill with liver disease.
